notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
🛠 Patch for CreepWars TD

A new patch is live – fixing several bugs and improving the overall gameplay experience. 
Thanks for your continued feedback and support!

🐞 Bug Fixes

    Path visualization has been fixed – paths are now displayed correctly again.

    Fun Map "Octobeerfeast": Fixed a game-breaking bug that caused the game to crash.

    Fun Map "Circle": Fixed a bug with range visualization.

    Undead Monstrosity (Level 4): Fixed issues with sound and attack behavior.

⚙️ Gameplay Changes

    Speed adjustments now apply to all difficulty levels.

    Scroll area in "Human Level 1" has been increased – giving you more room to maneuver.

Enjoy the game – and as always, I’d love to hear your feedback!

Cheers,
Christian

notes.title: Steam Tower Defense Festival UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone 
I have developed a new Undead campaign for the Steam Tower Defense Festival. 

You can now play the first level "Underground Ritual". The new campaign also introduces a new game mode in which there is no set number of lives, but a main building must be defended. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38091654/0a13db45fba3f45dba80aa0ca94a474ccc7da7c6.jpg

The opposing creeps run to the end of the path and then attack the next tower or the main building. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38091654/87f03a132b37a92eebac02d6ad56c70d6a15d77e.png

If you like it, please let me know. 
I am currently planning another 4 new levels. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38091654/8e07661ecce02a14d4873446bced43d0e677d66b.jpg

Have fun with the new faction!

notes.title: Pre-Release Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This is the pre-patch for the release on april 15th.
Please feel free to report any bugs and let me know if you like the changes.

Update:
- Added difficulty settings
- Added possibility to hide dialogues
- Added ingame graphics settings
- Ingame UI update
- Selection rectangle grey instead of green
- Maceman and Paladin now stun
- Handle death of creeps better (maybe for future features)
- Circular selection UI at selected entity
- Ingame sound adjustment
- Remove tooltip "free unit" from creeps
- Adjusted camera restrictions
- Added end of path visualization
- Updated the main menu
- Updated / added short keys
- Changed grass texture
- Updated all unit icons
- Amount of waves is now indicated next to the wave count
- Added footprints
- Updated waves in human level four

Fixed bugs:
- Rotation bug of Monstrosity
- Adjusted range tower positions in human level five and six
- Bug when Orc Shaman Wolfrider changes to ghost
- Next wave button now disappears immediately after clicking it
- Fixed rotation bug on summoned units

Thanks for playing

Fixed bugs:
-	Human campaign level 3 wave 12: Creeps falling from bridge (wave couldn’t be finished)
-	Human campaign level 4: Farmhouse model changes on zoom
-	Human campaign level 6: creeps don’t reach end of path
-	Human campaign bonus level: last wave monstrosity walk backwards
-	Sell mark on paladin (skull) always visible
-	Creeps fight tower bug (human creeps sometimes started to fight tower)
-	Rotation bug
-	Maceman dealing no damage
-	Minimap icons in Fun-Maps

Misc.:
-	New mouse pointer icon


Thanks for playing

notes.title: Update 0.0.9 optical overhaul of the human campaign
notes.notes:
Hi there,

To make the scenery feel more alive I have created new tree models which are moving in the wind.
I have decided to replace all the old tree models with those new ones so I went trough all existing levels replacing the trees. While doing so I also modified parts of the terrain and some props to slightly overhaul the whole look of the existing maps.

Before: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38091654/59f8dc06ef74df7e30e59da4c53a13a3fa22edfb.png

After:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38091654/8ad2103639f480d61f65126f8b93d27f738befb5.png

I have also reached out to Maxim Dobroshtan, a 2d concept artist, to create the key art for the game.

So far he made the new Cover art for steam: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38091654/ea78af5bf05e7c75487fca7171abe7a31161adba.png

And the new logo:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38091654/1fe6c1fcaee0cc8e22660ab747f453fb25aecfab.png

Please let me know if you like the new style of the environment.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update 0.0.8
notes.notes:
Hello there,

With this update I added the last level of the human campaign. The high priest Locath finished his ritual and is now able to summon powerful allies.
Additonaly I added an infobox with the armour type of the next wave.
I also fixed the map "Circle Map" by adding a new navigation system for creeps to prevent them from getting stuck.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Halloween Update 0.0.7
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

In this update you can play as the undead for the first time in the fun map "Halloween". These are part of the new campaigns that I am currently preparing. I would be happy if you extensively test the game mechanics of the undead and give me feedback.

In addition, the following changes have been implemented:
- Tier 4 units: These units have an additional special attack
- Damage over time attacks
- Attack switch: The possibility to switch between primary and secondary attacks has been implemented
- 13 new units, two new base towers
- Halloween Fun Map
 
Thank you for playing!
I look forward to further feedback.
